privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Your trust is the foundation of Lodgra. This policy explains what data we process, why, who we share it with and how you can exercise your rights under the GDPR (European Union) and the LGPD (Brazil).

controller.title: Data controller
controller.p1: The controller of personal data for Lodgra (lodgra.io) users is Fabio Gomes, operator of Lodgra, based in Portugal.
controller.p2: Contact for privacy and data protection matters: {email}.

roles.title: Two different roles
roles.i1: Account data of our Customers (name, email, billing): Lodgra is the controller.
roles.i2: Data the Customer enters or imports about guests, owners and teams: the Customer is the controller and Lodgra acts as processor, following the Customer's instructions.
roles.n1: If you are a guest of a property managed with Lodgra, please contact your host first. We will help whenever asked.

dataCollected.title: Data we process
dataCollected.p1: We process only the data needed to provide the service:
dataCollected.i1: Account: name, email, phone (optional), company, role and preferences.
dataCollected.i2: Properties and reservations: addresses, calendars, dates, amounts, sales channels and notes.
dataCollected.i3: Guests: name, contact details, number of guests and stay details, entered by the Customer or received from booking channels.
dataCollected.i4: Payments: handled by Stripe. We receive only payment status and identifiers, never full card details.
dataCollected.i5: Reservation emails, only if the Customer connects Gmail (see section 4).
dataCollected.i6: Technical data: access logs, IP address, browser and device, for security and diagnostics.

gmail.title: Gmail connection and Google user data
gmail.p1: If the Customer connects a Gmail account, Lodgra requests read-only access (gmail.readonly). We use that access for a single purpose: finding reservation confirmation emails sent by booking platforms (Airbnb, Booking.com, VRBO, Flatio) and extracting reservation details — guest name, dates, amounts, number of guests and booking reference.
gmail.i1: We only search for messages from those senders; we do not read the rest of the mailbox.
gmail.i2: We never send, delete or modify emails.
gmail.i3: Google user data is never sold or used for advertising or to train AI models.
gmail.i4: No person reads email content, except with the Customer's permission, for security reasons or where required by law.
gmail.i5: The Customer can disconnect Gmail at any time in Lodgra Settings or at myaccount.google.com/permissions.
gmail.n1: Access tokens are stored encrypted (AES-256), and imported messages are deleted with the account or on the Customer's request.
gmail.n2: Lodgra's use and transfer to any other app of information received from Google APIs will adhere to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.

purposes.title: How we use data
purposes.p1: We use data only on an appropriate legal basis:
purposes.i1: Providing the contracted service: properties, reservations, payments and finance (performance of contract).
purposes.i2: Sending account and reservation notifications (performance of contract).
purposes.i4: Protecting the platform and preventing fraud (legitimate interest).
purposes.i5: Improving the product with aggregated, anonymous statistics (legitimate interest).
purposes.i6: Meeting legal and tax obligations (legal obligation).

sharing.title: Who we share data with
sharing.p1: We share data only with providers needed for the service, bound by data protection agreements:
sharing.i1: Supabase — database and authentication (servers in the European Union)
sharing.i3: Stripe — subscription and direct booking payments
sharing.i5: Google — Gmail API, only when the Customer connects it
sharing.i6: OpenAI and Anthropic — automated extraction of reservation email data, via business APIs that do not use the data to train models
sharing.i7: Meta (WhatsApp Business) — messaging, only when the Customer enables it
sharing.i8: Booking platforms (Airbnb, Booking.com and others) — through iCal links configured by the Customer
sharing.i9: Authorities — only when required by law

transfers.title: International transfers
transfers.p1: Some providers process data outside the European Economic Area, for example in the USA. In those cases, transfers rely on adequacy decisions (such as the EU-US Data Privacy Framework) or Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission.

security.title: Security
security.i2: AES-256 encryption for access tokens and sensitive credentials
security.i3: Isolation between organisations with Row-Level Security: each Customer can access only their own data
security.i6: Internal access limited to the minimum necessary

retention.title: Retention
retention.p1: We keep data while the account is active. After closure:
retention.i1: Data remains available for export for 30 days and is then deleted.
retention.i3: Billing data is kept for the period required by tax law.
retention.i4: Technical logs are kept for short periods, for security only.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.p1: Under the GDPR and the LGPD, you may at any time:
rights.i1: Access your data and find out how it is processed
rights.i4: Receive your data in a structured format (portability)
rights.i5: Restrict or object to certain processing
rights.i6: Withdraw consent, without affecting processing already carried out
rights.i7: Know who your data is shared with
rights.n1: To exercise these rights, write to {email}. We respond within 30 days at most.

authorities.title: Supervisory authorities
authorities.p1: If you believe your data has not been handled correctly, you can lodge a complaint with:
authorities.i1: Portugal: Comissão Nacional de Proteção de Dados (CNPD) — www.cnpd.pt
authorities.i2: Brazil: Autoridade Nacional de Proteção de Dados (ANPD) — www.gov.br/anpd

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.p1: We use only cookies essential to the platform (session, language and security). If we start using analytics or marketing cookies, we will ask for your consent first.

minors.title: Minors
minors.p1: Lodgra is intended for professional use by people aged 18 or over and does not knowingly collect data from minors as users.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.p1: We may update this policy. Material changes are announced by email at least 15 days in advance, and the date at the top of the page always shows the version in force.

contact.title: Contact
contact.p1: Questions about privacy or data protection? Get in touch:

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms explain, in plain language, the relationship between Lodgra and everyone who uses the platform to manage short-term rental properties.

provider.title: Who we are
provider.p1: Lodgra (lodgra.io) is short-term and vacation rental management software developed and operated by Fabio Gomes, based in Portugal ("Lodgra" or "we").
provider.p2: For any matter relating to these Terms, contact us at {email}.

acceptance.title: Acceptance
acceptance.p1: These Terms govern access to and use of Lodgra by property managers, owners and companies (the "Customer"). By creating an account or using the platform, the Customer accepts these Terms and the Privacy Policy. Anyone accepting on behalf of a company confirms they are authorised to bind it.

service.title: The service
service.p1: Lodgra is a SaaS platform that brings short-term rental operations into one place:
service.i1: Properties, reservations, guests and owners managed in a single calendar
service.i2: Calendar sync via iCal with Airbnb, Booking.com and other channels
service.i3: A direct booking page with online payment through Stripe, paid into the Customer's own account
service.i4: Optional reading of platform confirmation emails to complete reservation details
service.i5: Financial control: revenue, expenses, commissions and owner payouts
service.i6: Communication with guests and teams by email and WhatsApp
service.n1: Features evolve frequently. Changes that materially reduce the contracted service will be announced in advance.

account.title: Account and access
account.i1: The Customer must provide accurate information and keep it up to date.
account.i2: The Customer is responsible for keeping credentials confidential and for the actions of users they invite.
account.i3: Any unauthorised access must be reported immediately to {email}.
account.i4: An account can have several users with different access levels.
account.i5: Lodgra is intended for professional use by people aged 18 or over.

subscription.title: Plans, payment and cancellation
subscription.i1: Access is provided through a monthly subscription, according to the plan and prices published on lodgra.io at the time of purchase.
subscription.i2: Subscription payments are processed by Stripe. Lodgra does not store card data.
subscription.i3: The subscription renews automatically at the end of each period until cancelled.
subscription.i4: 7-day guarantee: if you cancel within 7 days of your first purchase, we refund 100% of the amount paid.
subscription.i5: After that, the Customer may cancel at any time; access continues until the end of the paid period, with no pro-rata refund unless required by law.
subscription.i6: Price changes are announced at least 30 days in advance and apply only from the next billing period.

directPayments.title: Direct bookings and guest payments
directPayments.p1: Direct booking payments are processed by Stripe Connect and go straight to the Customer's own Stripe account. The Customer is the seller to the guest and is responsible for prices, taxes, invoices, cancellation policy, refunds and the stay itself.
directPayments.p2: Lodgra provides the technology and is not a party to the contract between the Customer and the guest. Use of the Stripe account is subject to Stripe's terms.
directPayments.p3: Lodgra charges no commission on direct bookings; processing fees are charged by Stripe.

integrations.title: Third-party integrations
integrations.p1: Lodgra connects to third-party services (Airbnb, Booking.com, Google/Gmail, Stripe, WhatsApp, among others) via iCal, APIs or the Customer's own authorisation. These services have their own terms and may change or become unavailable outside Lodgra's control.
integrations.p2: Lodgra is not affiliated with, sponsored or endorsed by Airbnb, Booking.com or Google. The brands mentioned belong to their respective owners.
integrations.p3: iCal sync has delays inherent to the format. The Customer should confirm critical reservations and blocks on the source platforms.

ai.title: AI-powered features
ai.p1: Some features use AI models to extract reservation data from emails. Results go through automated checks and, when in doubt, are held for the Customer's review. The Customer should verify the data before using it for financial or tax decisions.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable use
acceptableUse.p1: The Customer agrees not to use Lodgra to:
acceptableUse.i1: Carry out illegal or fraudulent activities
acceptableUse.i2: Infringe third-party rights or the rules of booking platforms
acceptableUse.i3: Attempt to access other organisations' data or test security without authorisation
acceptableUse.i4: Transmit malicious code or overload the infrastructure
acceptableUse.i5: Send unsolicited communications (spam) to guests or third parties
acceptableUse.i6: Resell or sublicense the platform without a written agreement

data.title: Your data
data.p1: Data entered into Lodgra belongs to the Customer. Lodgra processes it only to provide the service, as described in the Privacy Policy.
data.p2: For guest, owner and team data entered by the Customer, the Customer is the controller and Lodgra acts as processor under the GDPR and Brazil's LGPD.
data.p3: The Customer may export their data or request its deletion at any time.

availability.title: Availability
availability.p1: We work to keep Lodgra available and secure, with monitoring and backups. Interruptions may occur for maintenance or supplier outages; planned maintenance is announced whenever possible. We do not guarantee uninterrupted availability.

liability.title: Limitation of liability
liability.p1: Lodgra is provided "as is". To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for lost profits, lost bookings or indirect damages, including those caused by third-party platform failures.
liability.p2: Lodgra's total liability is limited to the amount paid by the Customer in the 3 months before the event giving rise to it. These limits do not apply to wilful misconduct, gross negligence or rights that cannot be excluded by law.

termination.title: Closing an account
termination.p1: The Customer may close the account at any time. Lodgra may suspend or close accounts that breach these Terms or have overdue payments, with prior notice whenever possible.
termination.p2: After closure, data remains available for export for 30 days and is then deleted, unless the law requires it to be kept.

changes.title: Changes to these Terms
changes.p1: We may update these Terms. Material changes are announced by email at least 15 days in advance. Continuing to use Lodgra after that date means accepting the new version.

law.title: Governing law
law.p1: These Terms are governed by Portuguese law, and disputes are settled by the competent Portuguese courts.
law.p2: If the Customer is a consumer, they keep the rights guaranteed by the law of their country of residence, including, in Brazil, the Consumer Protection Code.

contact.p1: Questions about these Terms? Get in touch:
